note: Two sites 380 m apart on the uphill side of Oregon Road, a forest road off PA 915. SH026 Oregon Lower, 0.36 mile from the highway, is a gravel-and-grass opening about 25 m by 30 m some 55 m off the road, with easy access. SH025 Oregon Upper, 0.54 mile in, is a secluded grass clearing about 40 m across with room to turn, at the top of a 390-ft track that climbs about 10% and is, in the agency's words, 'uneven with water bars'. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
